experimental_method: In situ Raman spectroscopy in a high-pressure optical cell; CH4 mole fraction in liquid water in equilibrium with sI methane hydrate (no vapour phase) from the CH4/water Raman peak-area ratio, calibrated on CH4-water liquid-vapour solutions whose solubility came from the Duan and Mao equation of state.
uncertainties_stated: Not stated as a single figure; mean absolute deviation of Eq. (7) from the data 2.17%
